title: First Battle in History: Egypt vs Canaanites (1458 BC)
author: History Dose

The Battle of Megiddo in 1458 BC marks the first battle for which we have in-depth and reliable historical description i.e., “written history” as opposed to pre-history. Ancient Egypt receives intel of a mounting threat in Canaan, so pharaoh Thutmose III leads his first military expedition into Canaan to face a great force of Syrians, Canaanites, and other allies gathered under the Prince of Kadesh. The outcome of the battle will shape the course of Egyptian history.
